name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Carry the box to the exit' is exactly the carry-c-to-a pattern, captured by hard Existence(at_exit) plus hard Response(at_exit, holding_box), which (since at_exit is only the episode's last step) requires the box in hand on the exit step. 'whenever the box falls, pick it up again' is a hard Response(box_fell, holding_box), the right grounding given no pickup event proposition exists; it becomes owed on each fall and is cleared when the box is held again, with an uncleared fall or an exit without the box leaving a hard rule pending and failing the task. All three clauses trace to the task, no clause is added or missing, and priorities are correctly hard.

texts: When reaching the exit, the agent must be carrying the box.
After each box fall, the agent must pick the box up again so that it is holding the box again.
